name: How much does a garage conversion typically cost in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: How much does a garage conversion typically cost in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a garage conversion in Las Vegas varies significantly based on factors such as the size of the garage, the intended use of the new space (e.g., basic living area vs. full bathroom addition), material choices, and necessary utility extensions. Expect costs to range from $20,000 to $60,000 or more for a standard two-car garage. A detailed estimate from a local contractor is essential for an accurate project cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage conversion costs in Las Vegas typically range from $20,000 to $60,000+, depending on size, intended use, and material choices.
